title: Combine phone project connections
responsibility: Lists the phone account projects alongside granted Mac projects while keeping each request with its own authority.

inputs.name: CapacitorProjectsService.constructor.config
inputs.description: Contains the phone account bridge as cloud and the paired computer bridge as mac. Project IDs beginning with local- route to mac; all other project IDs route to cloud.

outputs.name: projects
outputs.description: Returns deduplicated projects from bridges that expose listProjects, keeping non-local IDs from cloud and local-* IDs from mac. Rejected sides are skipped unless every bridge that exposes listProjects rejects, in which case the promise rejects with the first rejection reason.

outputs.name: operations
outputs.description: Returns a bridge that routes each project operation using its projectId or the selected project and remembers which bridge started each run so cancellation goes there. Run-event listeners subscribe to both bridges, optional operations are exposed according to bridge availability, and terminal run events remove remembered routes.

errors.name: refused
errors.description: When the chosen bridge lacks the requested operation, the service throws an Error with message `This operation is not available for this project on this phone.` and code `method-denied`. Rejections from delegated operations propagate; listing ignores individual failures unless every bridge exposing listProjects rejects, then it rethrows the first rejection reason.

outputs.name: CapacitorProjectsService.connect
outputs.description: Returns a bridge whose project listing combines cloud account projects and Mac-local projects. Project operations route by input projectId or the selected project; run-event subscriptions use both bridges, and optional operations are exposed according to bridge availability.

inputs.name: CapacitorProjectsService.constructor.config
inputs.description: Contains the phone account bridge as cloud and the paired computer bridge as mac. Project IDs beginning with local- route to mac; all other project IDs route to cloud.

outputs.name: CapacitorProjectsService.constructor
outputs.description: Creates a service instance retaining the supplied config, with no selected project and no remembered run routes.
